### Fixes

- **Send directly on Android, for real.** The built-in file-transfer app was sent as a plain text message, so opening it showed "not found". It is now sent as a proper webxdc app.

### New

- **Velta Beam.** "Send directly" is now **Velta Beam**, with a new icon. It opens as a panel just below the chat header, so you can keep reading and writing while a file transfers; ⤢ expands it to full screen, ✕ closes it. The sender sees every receiver's progress ("N receivers", a percent bar each, "done" once the file's checksum is verified), which also works in group chats.
- **UnifiedPush mark for relays.** In the Relays list, a relay marked **(U)** has confirmed push notifications for this device (Android with a UnifiedPush distributor). No mark means it hasn't been confirmed; Velta never guesses.

### Improvements

- **Menu buttons close their menu.** The attach (📎) and chat-menu (⋮) buttons turn into an ✕ while their menu is open; tap again to close it.
- **Side-by-side test builds.** Manual Android CI builds install as "Velta Test" (`org.velta.test`) next to the regular app; releases are unchanged.
